_readme: Template for a feature-video product description_puck. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> and delete this _readme key before applying.

textSide is where the TEXT goes: 'left' = text left / video right, 'right' = text right / video left, 'above' = text stacked over the video. The user usually says where the VIDEO goes - that is the opposite value.
radius 16px and frame true match the product image stage, so the description looks like it belongs to the gallery above it.
No topOffset and no scrub length: nothing pins, so the sticky header and tab bar never overlap a section.
visibility strings: 'true' HIDES on that device. All 'false' here - one block serves desktop, tablet and mobile.
Repeat the block per feature, alternating textSide, and add any other blocks (Heading, SpecPanel) around them.
